verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and payments platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents one. The agentic-commerce pages cover issuing cards to agents via API, and an llms.txt file exists; both are adjacent capabilities, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
